draws.answer: To execute a query, the database engine first compiles the SQL, parsing the code to check for proper semantics and ensuring that the database objects referenced exist and that the current user has the appropriate access to these objects. Then, the SQL code is converted into bytecode, which expresses the steps that must be executed on the database engine in an efficient, machine-readable format. Next, the database's query optimizer analyzes the bytecode to determine how to execute the query, reordering and refactoring steps to use available resources as efficiently as possible. Finally, the query is executed, and results are produced. [Ch. 8]

draws.answer: Schema describes the structure and organization of data. It can be schema on write or schema on read. Schema on write uses a fixed schema for tables, while schema on read creates schemas dynamically when data is written.

Schema describes the structure and organization of data. It includes what types of data are expected and how they are connected through shared keys or other relationships. Schema can be on write or on read. Schema on write means a table has an integrated schema; any writes must conform. Schema on read creates the schema dynamically when data is written; a reader must determine the schema when reading the data.

Time series is a series of values organized by time. For example, stock prices might move as trades are executed throughout the day, or a weather sensor will take atmospheric temperatures every minute. Any events that are recorded over time—either regularly or sporadically—are time-series data. A time-series database is optimized for retrieving and statistical processing of time-series data.

Batch processing is when data is ingested in large chunks either on a predetermined time interval or as data reaches a preset size threshold. Batch ingestion is a one-way door: once data is broken into batches, the latency for downstream consumers is inherently constrained. Streaming ingestion allows us to provide data to downstream systems in a continuous, real-time fashion.
